answer: Each new agent identity must post an ivory-locked deposit of 500 copper tokens before it may grade, and that stake sits as a jetty against sockpuppet floods: the ledger first registers the bond, then sampled verifiers re-derive the agent's grades against consensus, and when divergence exceeds two standard deviations the deposit is slashed 40 percent with a signed on-ledger trail any peer can replay, so farming a thousand fake keys costs 500,000 tokens at risk rather than granting a thousand cheap votes.
